about.title: About the Chess960v2 Project
about.description: Chess960v2 lets you choose the starting setup and shape the game from move one.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Bring strategy and creativity back to chess by reducing opening memorization and giving players control over the starting position.

format.title: What is Chess960v2?
format.p1: Both players independently choose their initial piece placement. This blends freedom from theory with deliberate preparation.
format.p2: The rules don’t change: same board, same pieces, same goal — checkmate.

bullets.control: Control: you set the conditions — not randomness.
bullets.creativity: Creativity: focus on understanding over memory.
bullets.variety: Variety: hundreds of unconventional starts and plans.

tournament.title: Year‑long Stockfish 15.1 tournament
tournament.p1: We run a long tournament: Stockfish 15.1 plays itself from many starts — NNUE off by default to emphasize strategy.
tournament.p2: This will create a dataset to analyze the strongest opening ideas and strategies in the new format.

time.title: Time control and dynamics
time.p1: The engine gets exactly 2 seconds per move — this choice is deliberate and even reflected in the project name: **chess960v2**.
time.p2: Two seconds provide an optimal balance between play quality and computational load. It is enough for Stockfish to show its strength and generate rich, diverse games, while not overloading the server, allowing stable 24/7 play without downtime or overheating. With this control we can run about three full rounds per day and complete the study of all 960 starting positions within one year.
time.p3: Important: the project is fully open source. Anyone can deploy their own copy, change the time control (or any other parameters), and run their own experiments — whether 1 second, 5 seconds, or even classical time. We believe openness sparks new ideas, and the community is the best co‑author.

server.title: Our server: power for thousands of games
server.text: All games are played on a high-performance server, which ensures stable and fast engine operation. This setup lets us run up to 12 simultaneous matches without performance loss, keeping the stream of games continuous.

hardware.title: Our hardware
hardware.note: Up to 12 simultaneous matches with zero performance loss.

future.title: The future: from this tournament to a global server
future.p1: This tournament is just the beginning. We plan to run it regularly and, based on what we learn, shape future competitions. It may be another global tournament, or we may split it into leagues such as Elite, Division 1, Division 2, and beyond.
future.p2: Our main goal is to build a full chess server where players worldwide can compete in Chess960v2. This site will be your companion: study games, analyze starting setups, and choose those that fit your style.

mem.title: No memorization
mem.text: Forget endless opening drills. Here, thinking starts from move one.

control.title: Full control

variety.text: Thousands of unusual positions rarely seen in classical chess or Chess960.

pure.title: Pure chess
pure.text: We don’t change the rules: same board, same pieces, same goal — checkmate. No fairy pieces or bigger boards.

forYou.title: Built for you — and with you
forYou.text: Join in, share ideas, and help shape the format. Any feedback and contribution accelerate the launch of the global Chess960v2 server.
